TLINE.TDLINE: &USE&
Register Customer Enhancements here and define parameters for the
enhancements. There are different options to setup, like activation of
call tracking, render an enhancement active, maintaining parameter
values with different sources etc.
All entries of this customizing are collected in a transport and parts
of it can be overwritten in the non-transportable customizing, e.g. the
activation.
&STANDARD_SETUP&
Enhancements are normally bigger areas where enhancements occur. They
can be structured in sub-enhancements and below that features. A
description should be provided to explain the purpose of the
enhancementin general.
Enhancements can be assigned to a "Product". A product is an artifact
form the Open FI Enhancement Framework and is part of the BTE (business
transaction events). Customer-Products can be found in TBE24. This
assignment of a BTE-Product is not mandatory. But if a product is
assigned, then the (de)activation of that product is considered for the
enhancement.
Enhancements can be set as active or not and the tracking of the calls
of this enhancement also can be activated or deactivated. The tracked
usage is collected in tables /S4P0/T_ENH_EUSE (raw data) and monthly
cumulated data in table /S4P0/T_ENH_EUSM.
As sub-element for enhancements there can be free values/parameters
assigned. How these parameters are used depends on the enhancement
itself.
There are three possible sources how parameter can be customized:
Direct value maintenance: there are Fix Value 1 ... 3 for enhancement
values
Parameter from STVARV: normally those parameters are maintained for
report variants. Parameter and Select-Options can be used and makes that
a powerful option to use the same parameters that are already available
for report variants.
Parameter from XML-Container (not yet implemented)
&ACTIVITY&
The cumulation is done via report /S4P0/BC_ENH_USAGE_CUMULAT and needs
to be scheduled as job in each system/client.
New enhancements and sub-Enhancements should be also in parallel to the
customizing registered in the interface class /S4P0/IF_ENH_CONSTANTS and
in the coding the attributes of the class have to be used and not the
literals from customizing.
In the enhancement coding the class /S4P0/CL_ENH_CORE=>GET_INSTANCE( )
needs to be included (see example below).
&EXAMPLE&
Enhancement: /s4p0/if_enh_sample_constants=>gc_enh_sample
Sub-Enhancement: TOC_PROCESS (/S4P0/IF_ENH_CONSTANTS=>GC_SUBENH_CTS_TOC)
Parameter-Name: EXAMPLE
Value1: 4711
Description: "Test-Entry"
Class: /S4P0/CL_IM_BC_CTS_REQ_ENH XXX
Coding of usage:
DATA(lr_enh_frw) = /S4P0/cl_enh_core=>get_instance(
iv_enhancement = /S4P0/IF_ENH_CONSTANTS=>gc_enh_cts
iv_sub_enhancement = /S4P0/IF_ENH_CONSTANTS=>gc_sub_enh_cts_toc ).
IF lr_enh_frw->is_enhancement_active( ) = abap_false.
RETURN.
ENDIF.
DATA(lt_parameters) = lr_enh_frw->get_enh_params_all( ).
